text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're wishing me a happy birthday 
too, Yukino? Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course~! But, umm... Truth is, I 
haven't gotten your present ready yet...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's totally fine. Just hearing you say 
happy birthday is more than enough to make 
me happy.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't find anythin' fancy that 
City-san might like...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm just gonna ask directly 
what they want and go buy it, but 
still...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: What I want, huh... Anything goes?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Pl-Please don't hesitate to ask for 
anything~! Whether it's snacks or 
cosmetics...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
In that case... Could you give me... some 
time to enjoy shopping with my friends?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I mean, if you're agonizing over it that 
much, wouldn't it be faster to just go 
together?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Is somethin' like that really okay?! 
Wahhh, goin' shopping with City-san...!
